Name: Beatrice NPC
Author: attonbomb
Description:
Beatrice is designed to live in the lighthouse in East Scarpe (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787) created by LemurKat and Kdau .

She has seasonal sprite and portrait variations, including for the festivals she comes to.

[b]Birthday[/b]: Spring 17

[b]Loves[/b]: Frozen Tear, Potato, Parsip Soup
[b]Like[/b]: Anchor, Bean Hotpot
[b]Dislike[/b]: Seaweed, Fried Calamari
[b]Hate[/b]: Fish

She spends most of her time keeping watch over the sea and has to get back to the ligthouse every evening to make sure the light is lit. Every week she heads into town to shop at Pierre's and she reads to the kids at the library once a month.

She has dialogue for all heart levels and as you get to know her, she'll start to open up a bit about her life.


[b]FUTURE PLANS:[/b]

Heart events
Her own room (currently she just stands at the bottom of the ladder into the lighthouse every evening)
Interaction with other characters

[b]Required Mods
[/b]Escape to East Scarpe
SMAPI
Content Patcher
TMXL Toolkit

[b]Compatability
[/b]Beatrice was built using SVE, but should work fine without. Her festival locations might be a bit off without SVE.

Downloads.Description: Beatrice as a .zip, for those who can't open the .rar (sorry!).
